items.body: Choose the Everett, Kingsley, or Noel. Dresses arrive un-hemmed; many dry cleaners offer hemming.

items.body: We wear a black shirt under the jacket instead of white, with a bowtie or long tie. Any collar style is fine, and any vendor is fine.

items.body: If tuxes and dresses aren't your style, anything formal and all black works. Formal black closed-toe shoes are part of every uniform.

blocks.heading: Obtaining a String Instrument
blocks.md:
A quality instrument is essential. Poor quality instruments cause
frustration for the student and prevent adequate progress.

Be very cautious of cheap instruments sold online — often called
"V.S.O.s," or Violin Shaped Objects. They frequently need repairs that cost
more than the instrument did. If the price sounds too good to be true, it
probably is.

## Questions to ask before you rent

- What is the rental schedule — monthly, quarterly, or something else?
- Does **100%** of what you pay in rent apply toward an eventual purchase?
- Can you trade up to a larger size as your child grows?
- Is insurance included, and what exactly does it cover?
- Which repairs are covered under the rental agreement?

## What a good shop provides

- Brand-name strings
- On-site setup of bridge, soundpost, and fittings, so the instrument is
  ready to play when you get it
- A real horsehair bow, already rosined
- Qualified luthiers doing repairs in house
- Regular visits to the school

## Accessories every student needs

- A cleaning cloth and rosin
- A rigid shoulder rest — violin and viola
- A rock stop — cello and bass

blocks.heading: Summer programs
blocks.intro: Students who want to keep playing over the summer have good options close to home.

items.title: Summer Arts Intensive, Kennesaw State University
items.detail: Taught by faculty from the Atlanta Symphony Orchestra.

items.title: UGA Summer Music Camp
items.detail: Five-day residential camp with masterclasses. Rising 9th graders and up, placement audition required.

items.title: Atlanta Chamber Music Festival, Emory University
items.detail: Seven-day residential chamber music program, grades 6–12. Applications due May 1.

items.title: FSU String Orchestra Camp
items.detail: Week-long intensive with sectionals, masterclasses, chamber ensembles, and theory.
